layoutPrinciples: Dark graphite split hero with subtle signal-lime halo and an embedded bright white interactive calculator panel.
Bright dashboard canvas (#F6F7F5) below the fold with softly rounded white cards, pale lime KPI wash, and accessible SVG donut & bar charts.
Product-led neobank restraint with pill-rounded primary CTAs and clean tabular financial tables.

componentStyling.accent: Signal lime (#A7FA3B) paired with dark ink (#151A15) and pale lime wash (#E8F9D5)

imageryGuidance: Subtle radial atmospheric lime halo behind hero; clean data visualizations (donut and rounded bar charts) carry visual weight without decorative clutter.
accessibilityNotes: Ink (#151A15) on white/lime-wash achieves >14:1 contrast; slate text (#505850) on #FFFFFF exceeds 7.1:1 WCAG AA/AAA. Signal lime CTA buttons strictly use #151A15 ink text (13.8:1).
